questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Anant was recording a new song in his studio.

options.text: In his studio Anant will record a new song.
A new song had been recorded by Anant in his studio.
In his studio a new song was recorded by Anant.
A new song was being recorded by Anant in his studio.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. '****A new song was being recorded by Anant in his studio.'**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **given sentence is in the Active Voice**. As per the given direction,** we have to change the sentence into Passive form. **
 
• The given sentence is written in** ‘Past continuous form. **
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• **Active Voice:** Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object.
 
• **Passive Voice:** Subject (Objective Case) + was/were + being+ V3 + by + Object (subjective case) 
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• **Active voice:** Sapna was writing a poem in the notebook.
 
• **Passive voice:** A poem was being written by Sapna in the notebook.
 
 
 
• The **subject of the given sentence is '****Anant****'** and **the object of the given sentence is '****a new song'. **
 
• So, in the passive voice, the position of **‘subject’ **and **‘object’ **will be interchanged**. **
 
• Also here, **'****was recording****'**** **will be changed into** ****'****was being recorded.'**
 
• So, **the correct answer is option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:**__ *A new song was being recorded by Anant in his studio.*

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

“Vidushi, the doctor has advised me to avoid sugar,” said Prabha.

options.text: Prabha told Vidushi that the doctor had advised her to avoid sugar.
Prabha said to Vidushi that the doctor was advising her to avoid sugar.
Prabha told Vidushi that the doctor advised her to avoid sugar.
Prabha told Vidushi that the doctor will be advising her to avoid sugar.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. ‘****Prabha told Vidushi that the doctor had advised her to avoid sugar.’**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Direct Speech**. 
 
• As per the given question we have to change it into **Indirect Speech.**
 
• The process of this transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The conjunction **'that' will be added** and **comma and inverted commas will be removed.**
 
• In the Indirect speech **'said' will be changed into ‘told’** because reporting verb has an object, ‘Vidushi’.
 
• **'me'** will be changed into** 'her'.**
 
• Here, **‘has advised’ is in the present perfect tense** and **will be changed into past perfect i.e., ‘****had advised’.**
 
 
 
• ​So, according to the above steps, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:**__ *Prabha told Vidushi that the doctor had advised her to avoid sugar.*
